summary: Image archives give the two ends of the comparison separately — segmented 3D shapes of packed epithelial cells (BioImage Archive S-BIAD843), cultured-cell images in IDR, bacterial shape classes in BacDive — but no dataset codes contact pressure or growth mode alongside the outline, none pairs free-growing with confined cells of the same kind, and AlgaeBase's API needs a key. Curvature/facet frequencies would have to be computed from the images; the whole-organism half of the claim has no dataset.
next_step: Define a facet-frequency metric and pre-register a comparison of sparse vs confluent cells in one IDR screen (density as the pressure proxy) against crystal habit as the control class; the imbibition variable cannot be sourced.
obstacles_confirmed: Growth by imbibition is not directly annotated.
Pressure is rarely coded alongside the image.
Shape databases record outline class, not whether growth was by imbibition.
